fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the generated image. Total pixels must be between 921600 and 4624220, with aspect ratio between 1/16 and 16.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The file format of the generated image.

fields.name: watermark
fields.title: Watermark
fields.description: Whether to add the provider's visible watermark.

fields.name: background
fields.title: Background
fields.description: Use `transparent` with exactly one alpha-channel reference and PNG output to preserve transparency.

fields.name: enhance_prompt_mode
fields.title: Enhance Prompt Mode
fields.description: Prompt optimization mode. `standard` prioritizes image quality; `fast` reduces generation time.
